method: Seven warmed batches with tiered compilation disabled for stable optimized JIT, allocation measured on the executing managed thread. Fixed seed=1, 8 seats, same standard active general pool and human PlayCard boundary for both catalogs; short-prefix replay. Isolates catalog-size overhead, not classic-pool gameplay. This is a microbenchmark, not long-game/UI acceptance or a historical regression comparison.
